attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf_text_extraction_and_structure_detection
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "authenticated_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/client/pdf/selected_file"
      description: "Receive the PDF file selected by the user in the browser"
    output: raw_pdf_data

  - id: step_validate_pdf
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_data
      schema: pdf_file_schema
      rules:
        - "must_have_text_layer"
        - "valid_pdf_binary"
    output: validated_pdf

  - id: step_iterate_pages
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf
      iterator: page
      description: "Load the PDF and iterate over each page"
    output: pdf_pages

  - id: step_extract_text_items
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: pdf_pages
      field: "text_items_with_font_size"
      description: "Extract all text items along with their font size metadata from each page"
    output: raw_text_items

  - id: step_validate_text_items
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_text_items
      schema: text_items_schema
      rules:
        - "each_item_has_text_content"
        - "each_item_has_font_size_number"
    output: validated_text_items

  - id: step_compute_median_font_size
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      group_by: "all"
      operation: "median"
      field: "font_size"
      description: "Compute the median font size to establish the body text baseline"
    output: median_font_stats

  - id: step_merge_text_with_median
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      secondary: median_font_stats
      key: "global"
      description: "Attach median font size to each text item for comparison"
    output: text_items_with_baseline

  - id: step_apply_heading_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: text_items_with_baseline
      rule: "font_size_ratio_comparison"
      condition: "item.font_size > median_font_size * 1.2"
      classify_as: "heading"
      default_class: "body_text"
      description: "Classify text items with font size significantly above the median as headings using font-size ratio"
    output: classified_text_items

  - id: step_transform_structured_output
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: classified_text_items
      mapping:
        headings: "items where classification == heading"
        body: "items where classification == body_text"
        structure: "hierarchical_document_tree"
      description: "Reshape classified items into structured document with headings and body text"
    output: structured_document

  - id: step_format_result
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: structured_document
      format: "json"
      locale: "fr-FR"
      description: "Serialize the structured document for the French-language academic PDF reader"
    output: formatted_result

  - id: step_log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      action: "pdf_text_extraction_completed"
      details: "Client-side PDF text extraction and heading structure detection finished"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      message: "Extraction du texte et détection de la structure terminées avec succès."
      channel: "browser_ui"
    output: notification_result
dsl_type_errors: Step 'step_transform_structured_output': op 'transform_json' requires input of type 'records' but 'classified_text_items' has type 'boolean'. Make sure the step producing 'classified_text_items' uses an op that outputs a list of records (e.g. fetch_api, filter_records, validate_schema, read_database).
